messages:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: spike in smart-routing errors and cross-region fallbacks. 5xxs observed, client timeouts. Paging on-call (P1) :rotating_light:
rumi: saw the alert. looks like a policy change just rolled. tagging devon and michael.
devon: oncall here, joining. any idea which change?
michael: I pulled logs — policy service returned an empty 'variants' array during evaluation, then fallback kicked to region 'eu-west' repeatedly. this smells like a schema/defaulting change.
anya: which deploy introduced the schema change? I see a config migration earlier today from product-configs service.
rumi: @deploy-bot can you show the config migration that went out at ~10:12 UTC?
deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-15T10:12Z: config-migration v2.7.1 applied to product-configs. Diff summary: removed deprecated field `fallback_region` in favor of `fallback.policy` object.
chris: here's the diff excerpt I grabbed from the release notes:
```
- routing_defaults: 
-   fallback_region: eu-west
+ routing_defaults:
+   fallback:
+     policy: auto
```
michael: aha — the migration dropped the explicit fallback_region value for customers relying on the deprecated field. default behavior appears to be 'first available region' which is resolving to eu-west for many routes. that caused repeated region hopping as capacity checks fail -> fallback -> route -> fail -> fallback loop.
devon: confirmed in traces: request chain shows repeated policy evaluation and requeueing across regions ~3-6 times before timeout.
rumi: customer impact?
support-bot: initial metrics from 10:15-10:35 UTC: ~2.1% of production requests experienced >3s added latency, 0.4% 5xx increase overall. A subset of customers in NA saw routing into EU, increasing latency. No data loss.
anya: mitigation plan: 1) temporarily disable cross-region fallback 2) restore fallback_region defaults for affected routes 3) rollback migration on product-configs if needed. who can flip the circuit breaker?
michael: I can patch policy-service to return previous default; faster is to flip a feature flag that the migration added. where is that flag?
devon: flag name `enable_new_fallback_schema` in system-features. I can set it to false now.
rumi: please do that and watch errors. also create a temporary rate-limit to reduce requeueing.
devon: running:
```bash
rdctl features set enable_new_fallback_schema false --scope=global --reason="emergency rollback after unintended defaults"
```
deploy-bot: feature toggle applied (tx id f3a9b). Please allow ~15s for propagation.
michael: flipping now to disable cross-region fallback at routing layer:
```bash
kubectl exec -n routing policy-ctrl -- rdctl policy update routing-defaults --set enable_cross_region_fallback=false
```
sarah: applied. monitoring dashboards show error rate dropping. tailing logs.
chris: support: drafting customer message that some requests were routed to unintended regions causing latency spikes. no security breach. ETA for full resolution?
support-bot: drafting note for impacted customers; will include timeline and mitigation steps.
rumi: next: restore explicit fallback_region for routes that relied on deprecated field. I have a script to map old configs from backups and apply. I'll start with the top 20 routes by traffic.
anya: if we can restore defaults quickly it's better than full rollback. but we should also patch the migration to populate the new `fallback.policy` from the deprecated field.
michael: agreed — we need a short-term restore + medium-term patch + postmortem.
devon: rolling the restore for first 20 routes now. applying as patch:
```json
{"routing_defaults": {"fallback": {"regions": ["us-east-1"]}}}
```
(small note: using API v1 because v2 validates too strictly right now)
rumi: logs show requeueing rate cut in half after the flag flip. errors trending down.
sarah: monitoring shows p50 latency back to baseline, p95 still slightly elevated but improving.
chris: handoff: devon you take next 30 mins, then michael will take over for on-call. I need to loop in GTM for customer comms.
devon: ack, standing by. I'll put runbook steps in the thread.
michael: I'll prepare a patch for the migration: populate new `fallback.policy.regions` from deprecated `fallback_region` when present. also include a validation test to catch empty variants array.
rumi: support-bot, please tag affected customer list and severity.
support-bot: tagged: internal-impact-list-03; severity: medium for ~2k customers (sporadic). we recommend a short incident notice.
chris: Is rollback of the product-configs migration required?
michael: not if we can backfill the new schema from backups and flip the feature flag off. rollback is heavier and risks other regressions.
anya: timeline: 10:12 change -> 10:15 first errors -> 10:22 feature flag flip -> 10:30 initial restores -> 10:40 metrics stable.
rumi: please capture the RCA points: - migration dropped deprecated field -> defaulting behavior changed - policy evaluator didn't validate empty variants - no canary on high-traffic routes - monitoring alert threshold too permissive for early detection
chris: assigning postmortem lead: sarah. devon will prepare the timeline. michael will prepare the code fix. anya will own release gating.
support-bot: customer note ready draft. send approval?
sarah: approved, send now to impacted list. include mitigation steps and expected full fix ETA 24h.
devon: adding runbook entry: if fallback spikes, flip `enable_new_fallback_schema` false, and set `enable_cross_region_fallback=false`.
michael: creating PR for migration patch and tests. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/product-configs/pull/482
rumi: great. handoff: devon you'll stay for 30 more minutes then michael takes over. any final checks?
devon: watching metrics. will update if any regression.
rumi: closing pager for now to avoid alert fatigue; we'll keep the thread open for final RCA notes. thanks all :heart:
support-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied, major impact reduced. next update in 2h or on PR merge.
